candidates.change_summary: Replace the revert guard so that SetMinSum only sets MinSum when already initialized (inverse condition).
Remove the revert guard so SetMinSum can always set MinSum regardless of initialization.
Change assignment to add to MinSum instead of overwriting it.
Change assignment to subtract the provided value from MinSum.
Assign MinSum to zero unconditionally (ignoring the provided value).
Replace the conditional that reverts when already initialized with an assignment that sets MinSum only if not initialized, allowing calls after initialization to change MinSum (no revert).
Remove the guard and always set MinSum (delete the revert check), allowing updates even after initialization.
Invert the initialized check so the function reverts when not initialized instead of when initialized, preventing initial setting but allowing changes after Initialized() is called.
Change the guard to set MinSum only when already initialized; otherwise revert, making initial call fail but subsequent calls succeed.
Add an extra assignment that doubles the value after setting, so observable MinSum becomes twice the provided value.
Replace the body to allow SetLogFile only when already initialized (invert the original guard).
Replace the body to set Log unconditionally (remove the initialization guard).
Replace the body to set Log only if caller is the zero address (effectively preventing normal calls from changing Log).
Replace the body to set Log to a fixed address (ignore provided parameter).
Replace the line that sets acc.unlockTime to use block.timestamp instead of block.timestamp+_lockTime, making the lock become current time rather than extended by _lockTime when larger.
Replace the require that checks for overflow of lock time with a no-op (deleted) by replacing it with a different require that checks msg.value>0, changing behavior when zero-value puts are allowed.
Replace the balance increment so that msg.value is not added (no-op on balance), preventing balance growth on Put.
Replace the call to Log.AddMessage with a no-op (deleted), removing the external log message generation during Put.
